answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 110 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes an echo bet on surviving 110 epochs of grading, and every lantern settlement recomputes the willow schedule, so a hostile operator who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is as a result worth nothing for 16 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
